## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today? Describe the situation, not the solution.

The change you have in mind.

## Where it belongs

## Alternatives

Other ways you have tried or considered, including what you do now to work around it.

## Notes

Anything else that helps: examples, screenshots, links.
